body:
Thank you all for attending today! Here are the belated notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9598):

### Agenda  
Attendees: Joey Arhar, Panos Astithas, Marcos Caceres, Mason Freed, Vladimir Levin, Olli Pettay, Michael Smith

1. Review past action items
    1. Brian will address review feedback on [Update the :dir / directionality to include shadow dom](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9166). 
    1. Yi will review [Reference even more baseline concepts in CSS Inline Layout](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/5826).
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. None.
1. New topics
    1. [Vladimir] [Proposal: fire an event before the first rendering opportunity after activation](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9315)
        1. Discussion about the developer ergonomics of adding a new event or using rAF for this. A new event provides more info via an event parameter and less code for handling.
        1. Discussed the interaction between a reveal event and renderblocking, as well as how Firefox could implement this.
        1. Marcos will find someone from WebKit to provide feedback.
        1. Vladimir will comment with an example of a rAF-based solution.

### Action Items

1. @marcoscaceres will find someone from WebKit to provide feedback on the [Proposal: fire an event before the first rendering opportunity after activation](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9315). 
2. @vmpstr will comment on the proposal above with an example of a rAF-based solution.
